note: Both sets struggle somewhat with the stacked bar charts, occasionally confusing the top y-axis value of a layer with its actual thickness. However, Set A makes this error more frequently (e.g., claiming glass_triax thickness is 55 mm and 40 mm). Set B correctly calculates some layer thicknesses by subtracting the underlying layers (e.g., medium_density_foam thickness of 8 mm on the FFA-W3-211 airfoil) and correctly identifies the 3 mm CarbonUD thickness on the 100% span chart.
